name: @red-cup-engineering/cryptographic-services-section
description: The union's canonical secp256k1 + keccak256 core: EVM identity, signing, hashing, and x402 settlement primitives, offered as a directly contractable service.

scripts.check: node --check src/law.mjs && node --check src/hash.mjs && node --check src/secp256k1.mjs && node --check src/keccak256.mjs && node --check src/evm.mjs && node --check src/cryptographic-services.mjs && node --check test/evm.test.mjs && node --check test/service-contracts.test.mjs

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: a directly addressed ActivityStreams solicitation naming one operation in the offer's operation set, with any private key supplied only as invocation input under the caller's own custody
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: unknown operations, key material requested inside an offer or persisted to any record, and requests to broadcast or move value (the section derives identity and signs; settlement broadcast belongs to the holding enterprise)
